title: The Price Is Hell — big update to my devil game-show Plinko roguelike (formerly Pegs & Prizes)
author: link1241
selftext:
Thanks to everyone who commented on the last posts. A lot changed since then:

A new board. Your winnings charge a summoning circle on it, and the pegs read better.

Instant replays of big drops, and if you'd rather not watch, BOO! it off the air.

The Host's contracts. He offers bargains for your soul: double-or-nothing coin flips, a copy of your best ball, longer claw reach, and more. Each contract you sign stays on his ledge as a trophy.

A new shop, the HELL-O-MAT. You type a code on its keypad and the item drops out.

Your balls live in a cage. Buy a new one and pick which ball it replaces.

Smaller things: you can poke the Host, the pause screen shows every Showdown ahead, new bag-picking doors, and lessons appear next to the thing they teach.

Still looking for feedback, especially on what confuses you and where it gets boring.

comments.author: link1241
comments.body: I would really like to know what ypu guys think about the concept and the art
